$comment: One shard of the signal-lens catalogue. DATA, never loaded whole into an agent context. Validate with: python3 scripts/validate_catalogue.py

signals.name: Product comparison
signals.definition: The subject places two or more specific products, plans, or vendors side by side, or repeatedly views the same competing set within a session window. Qualifying condition: at least two distinct product or plan identifiers appear in one comparison context, or a dedicated comparison surface is opened.
signals.question_answered: Has the buyer moved from browsing a category to narrowing a shortlist, and which alternatives are still live?

capability_ladder.how: Instrument comparison_started / comparison_updated / comparison_completed on your own comparison tool or plan table
capability_ladder.gives: First-party, full fidelity, no third party involved

capability_ladder.how: Infer from consecutive product-detail views of two or more items in the same category inside one session
capability_ladder.gives: Lower precision, but needs no new instrumentation

capability_ladder.how: Category-level comparison intent from a review-platform partner programme
requires: paid vendor listing in that category
capability_ladder.gives: Account-level only, and only if your category is listed

access_conditions: Rung 3 is obtainable only by becoming a listed vendor; it cannot be bought as raw data

freshness.note: A comparison is meaningful while the shortlist is open; it decays as the buyer either commits or lapses.

false_positives: Existing customer checking whether to upgrade rather than buy
